fusions.name: Branching Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a two-pronged barb that deals 7 piercing damage to the first enemy it meets and splits to 1 more within 3 tiles for the full amount. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Two-Tined Thrust
fusions.desc: Strikes 2 times, one with each prong, each strike dealing 10 piercing damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Pronged Palisade
fusions.desc: Plants a row of prongs 5 tiles long that blocks enemies for 6 seconds. Anything that strikes it moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Other Prong
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
